purpose: Define the bounded, low-energy first physical-validation program before any fabrication order is allowed.

rationale: USB-C 5 V sink to 3.3 V logic is bounded to extra-low-voltage operation.
The ESP32-C3 plus I2C environmental-sensor path has observable power and functional checkpoints.
The first program excludes mains, battery charging, high-energy loads, medical, automotive-safety, and production qualification claims.

selection_decision.non_claim: This decision approves the bounded reference-board selection only; it is not schematic, layout, component, manufacturing, procurement, or fabrication approval.

blocking_reasons: The legacy template-generated esp32_usb_sensor_generated_v1 candidate uses ESP32-WROOM-32 and does not satisfy the selected ESP32-C3 USB-C sink contract; it is not a fabrication source.

The composition-synthesis candidate has the required ESP32-C3 and dual 5.1k USB-C CC pull-down topology and routes all six non-ground nets, but GND pour connectivity is not yet proven and internal DRC remains blocked; official KiCad DRC and profile-bound DFM also remain blocking.
The current generic KiCad schematic export is not ERC-clean because it emits floating net-name labels; an ERC-clean reviewed schematic is still required.
Profile-bound DFM is currently hard-fail for the candidate layout and must be cleared before an ordered bundle can be frozen.
Exact orderable identities and qualified review for all populated components and high-risk footprints remain to be frozen before procurement or fabrication.
design readiness is blocked until exact component identity, ERC/DRC, and profile-bound DFM checks are satisfied
Qualified human schematic/layout/component/manufacturing review is not recorded.
No exact ordered manufacturing bundle is hash-bound to a released source revision.
The committed benchmark golden files are starter fixtures and are forbidden as fabrication sources.

power_scope.current_limit_role: initial bench protection, not a design-rating claim

planned_rail_checks.basis: planning assumption; replace or confirm from reviewed source evidence before fabrication
planning assumption; replace or confirm from reviewed regulator/load evidence before fabrication

stop_conditions: bench supply enters current limit or measured input current exceeds 0.5 A
visible smoke, odor, discoloration, arcing, or unexpected component heating is observed
VBUS or the 3.3 V rail is outside the reviewed pre-fabrication acceptance range
a continuity or short check fails before power application
any component surface measurement reaches 70 C during the bounded initial bring-up

non_claims: The committed benchmark starter fixture is coverage evidence only and must not be used as a fabrication source.
This pre-fabrication plan is not fabrication approval, human engineering approval, electrical correctness, EMC evidence, regulatory evidence, certification, or production readiness.
Planning voltage ranges, current limits, and temperature stops are conservative test-planning assumptions until confirmed against the exact reviewed component and board evidence.
No physical board, assembly, bring-up, measurement, or lab correlation result is claimed by this record.
